2609.09698.title: Kernel-Complexity Edge Sanitization for Training-Free Defense against Structural Graph Attacks
2609.09698.paper_summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse applications, yet they remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks that maliciously perturb graph structure. Existing defenses often lack rigorous theoretical grounding, rely on attack-specific heuristics, or require costly retraining procedures such as adversarial training. To address these limitations, we propose Kernel-Complexity Edge Sanitization (KCES), a training-free and model-agnostic framework for defending against structural attacks. KCES is built upon Graph Kernel Complexity (GKC), a principled metric derived from the graph Gram matrix that appears in a generalization upper bound on the GNN test error. From this bound, we define an edge-specific KC score that quantifies each edge's structural influence via its induced change in GKC. KCES then identifies and prunes high-KC edges, which are empirically enriched with adversarial perturbations under structural attacks, to mitigate their harmful impact. Computationally efficient and scalable, KCES operates as a lightweight preprocessing step without retraining and can be seamlessly integrated with existing defenses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KCES consistently outperforms representative robust baselines across diverse attack settings and scales effectively to large graphs. Supported by theoretical analysis and extensive empirical validation, KCES provides a principled and efficient framework for securing GNNs. Our code is available at https://github.com/karpning/KCScore.
2609.09698.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡（GNNs）在多種應用中取得了顯著成功，但它們仍然對惡意擾動圖結構的對抗攻擊高度脆弱。現有的防禦措施往往缺乏嚴謹的理論基礎，依賴於特定攻擊的啟發式方法，或者需要昂貴的再訓練程序，例如對抗訓練。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了核複雜度邊緣清理（KCES），這是一個無需訓練且與模型無關的框架，用於防禦結構攻擊。KCES建立在圖核複雜度（GKC）之上，這是一個基於圖Gram矩陣的原則性度量，出現在GNN測試誤差的一個泛化上界中。根據這個上界，我們定義了一個邊緣特定的KC分數，量化每個邊緣通過其引起的GKC變化的結構影響。然後，KCES識別並修剪高KC邊緣，這些邊緣在結構攻擊下經驗上被對抗擾動所增強，以減輕其有害影響。KCES計算效率高且可擴展，作為一個輕量級的預處理步驟運行，無需再訓練，並且可以與現有的防禦措施無縫集成。大量實驗表明，KCES在各種攻擊設置中始終超越代表性的穩健基準，並且能有效擴展到大型圖。通過理論分析和廣泛的實證驗證，KCES提供了一個原則性和高效的框架來保護GNN。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/karpning/KCScore 獲得。
